N° 03Company site and project planner2026

Lemon Network Solutions

A network company whose quote is a designed book, not a spreadsheet.

Visit v0-lemon-network-solutions.vercel.app →How to use itWatch the purpose

I

Purpose

Let a business owner plan a network project in five minutes, see real products with real prices, reserve a consultation, and receive a book that is both the design and the quote.

II

The problem

Network quotes are usually a table nobody understands, sent after three calls. Owners cannot picture what they are buying and installers cannot install from it.

III

What I built

A planner that sizes the system from a few answers and assembles an estimate from real product photos and list prices plus labour. A reserve step whose fee is credited to the project. A ten page project book per client with the design, coverage maps, rack and cabling plan, bill of materials, timeline and signature lines. Sixteen case studies with drawings, an academy of thirty nine lessons, a shop of the whole catalogue, and two illustrated books.

IV

How it works

Large content lives on a CDN and is downloaded once per build. The planner uses the same sizing rules as the project book. Drawings come from the real floor plans and the book renders to a US Letter PDF.

V

Craft

Lemon yellow on charcoal, product photography credited, no owner name and no phone number anywhere.

VI

The purpose, in motion

A short motion design made for this book: four beats, one drawn shape each, the reason the project exists. Tap it to step through.

In short
